Hi team — technical summary and suggested wording below. I also attached the SOC2 excerpt and a CSV with retention windows.

Suggested customer-facing statement (legal-friendly):
"For Redwood’s hosted inference service, customer-provided input and generated outputs are not used to train, pre-train, or fine-tune Redwood public models. Redwood may collect limited, aggregated telemetry for service health and product improvement; such telemetry does not include customer content or identifiers. Customers who require model customization via a dedicated training engagement are handled under a separate contractual data processing and training program with explicit opt-in."

Retention windows (current default behavior):
- Inference request payloads (transient KV/cache and prefix cache): retained up to 30 days for request replay and cache warmups; purged per customer by default.
- Structured operational logs (request metadata, error traces): retained 90 days for monitoring and incident investigation; then aggregated or removed.
- Audit logs (access, key rotations, admin actions): retained 365 days to meet compliance obligations.
- Backups / DR snapshots: retained up to 365 days; snapshots are encrypted and access-limited.
- Crash or forensics artifacts: retained as needed for investigations, access controlled, and minimized.

Exceptions / clarifications:
- Aggregated telemetry (e.g., tokenization rates, latency histograms) may be retained longer in anonymized form to improve platform reliability.
- We do not use customer content to train public models in hosted offerings. Any training on customer customer data requires explicit opt-in and a separate agreement (Private/Enterprise training).
- Legal holds or regulatory requests may require retaining specific artifacts beyond the standard windows; in those cases we notify the customer and follow the DPA terms.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Excerpt_SOC2.pdf, retention_windows_table.csv

If this looks good I recommend we: (1) send the suggested statement verbatim to NovaRetail, (2) attach the SOC2 excerpt and retention CSV, and (3) include a link to the DPA for signature if they want the contractual commitment.

- Aditya
